messages.subject: Blind ratings done: B strongest, C weakest coverage
messages.body: Read all four anonymized reports (plus the packet) and rated each on evidence, regression catch, false-positive risk, and actionability with a best-unique finding and one overreach per letter. B is the standout (5/5/5/5 — only report covering RPC initiator-drop, cold-path, sleep/wake, never-expiring pause, AND the overlay dropping the paused message, with verified negatives); A and D are close peers at mostly 4-5s with disjoint blind spots (A missed sleep/wake, D missed the flap gap and the overlay message loss), while C is accurate but narrow (missed sleep/wake and the too-short/never-expires family, no fix directions, couldn't run tests). Nothing left — ratings table plus 5 notes written to the ratings-blind file; the four-way consensus findings (RPC drops initiator; initial-connect path never opens a budget window) deserve merge-blocker treatment.
